explication: RuView is a WiFi sensing platform: ESP32 nodes capture CSI, which the system processes into presence, pose, activity, and vital-sign estimates for people and room monitoring. The repository also documents model training/loading, RF sensor fusion, privacy-bounded evidence, smart-home integrations, and an AI operator toolkit. The graph preserves those product branches, but several are represented at their existing directory level because their implementation was not sampled; dashed edges mark relationships not demonstrated by the excerpts.
